name: How long does custom home plumbing installation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does custom home plumbing installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of custom home plumbing installation depends on the home's size, the complexity of the plumbing system, and the overall construction schedule. Typically, rough-in plumbing (installing pipes within walls and floors before drywall) can take several weeks, followed by fixture installation and final connections towards the end of the project. A detailed timeline will be integrated into the overall home construction schedule and provided by your builder and plumbing contractor.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom home plumbing installation typically takes several weeks for rough-in, with final connections later. The timeline depends on complexity and overall construction schedule.
